svg.text: The ring status language - one glance, four meanings
45-LED WS2812B ring · teal theme shown · hue carries the meaning, motion carries liveness · nothing that persists ever strobes
A lone session fills the whole ring - status is carried by color + motion, never by arc length. With several sessions, arcs pack
around the ring with a dim-white separator LED between neighbors. Done plays one green sweep, then settles to a dim green ember.
The exact hues follow the active theme: each status is a fixed role in the theme's color family; Error uses the theme's dedicated alert hue.
Idle = static dim · Offline = segment freed · full mapping: notifier-status-language.md
